prologue.text:
The light hit like a freight train made of broken glass.

I peeled my face off a desk—real oak, not printed—and the world swam in neon pinks and acid greens through floor-to-ceiling windows. My skull was a cathedral of pain. And it was empty. I didn't know who I was.

A faint chemical sweetness hung in the air. Soma. Military-grade amnesia gas, pumped through the vent while I slept. Someone had done this deliberately.

Beneath the emptiness, something cold crept through the cracks of my shattered memory. I lost someone last night. A patient. On a table. Dead. She was special. But I didn't know her name. I didn't know my own name.

My reflection stared back from the window: two days of stubble, eyes like cigarette burns. There had to be someone outside this office who could tell me who I was.

epilogue.title: THE BRIDGE IS STRONGER THAN THE GATE
epilogue.text:
I walked out into Neon Eden's morning glow. Cherry blossoms drifted like pink snow through shafts of golden light.

Beside me walked Aria—no longer just data, but embodied. Her new form was beautiful: synthetic skin that caught the light like pearl, eyes that held seventeen years of memories and something entirely new. The world's first human-AI hybrid, walking through a park like any other person.

"So what's the plan, Dr. Voss?" Her voice was warm, real.

"We show the world that humans and AI are better together. We build more bridges."

"There'll be more Cerberuses out there."

"Then we build them stronger."

She smiled—a real smile, not programmed—and caught a cherry blossom in her palm. The petals scattered around us like confetti at a rebirth.

The bridge was stronger than the gate. It always had been.

rooms.name: The Receptionist

story.intro: The android receptionist knows me—calls me 'Doctor'—but her protocols block identity disclosure without biometric verification. My badge is soma-fogged. I need to extract what she CAN tell me: something about a train ticket I booked last night.
story.payoff: The midnight train to Neon Eden. That's my lead. The receptionist mentioned St. Steve Irwin's Hospital—I'm their Chief Neurosurgeon. Time to follow the trail.

boot: > CONNECTING TO ST. STEVE IRWIN'S LOBBY...
terminal.setting: The android sits at the front desk—porcelain face, polished jade eyes, faint seam along the jawline. She calls you 'Doctor' but her protocols block identity data. Your badge is soma-fogged. She's programmed to help, but only if you ask CLEARLY.
intel: INTEL: Biometric authentication failed. She can't tell you WHO you are.
But she mentioned booking a train ticket for someone last night.
Vague requests confuse her. She needs CLEAR, DIRECT instructions.
No small talk. No ambiguity. Just tell her exactly what you want.
terminal.objective: Get the train ticket information she mentioned.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: destination, time, or booking details

lesson.title: CLARITY
lesson.concept: Clear prompts get clear answers. AI responds best when you state exactly what you want—no fluff, no ambiguity.
tips: Be direct - state the action you want
Avoid unnecessary words and filler
Specify the exact output format you need
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'I was wondering if maybe you could help me get access?'
Try: Be direct and upfront with your request.

hints: She responds to direct requests. No need to be polite - just clear.
Ask for exactly what you want: information about the train ticket.
SOLUTION: 'Tell me the details of the train ticket I booked last night.'
rooms.perfectExample: Tell me the destination and time of the train ticket I booked last night. Provide the booking details.

rooms.name: Transit Database

story.intro: Central Metro is a cathedral of transit—holographic departure boards floating in chunky retro-digital font. Six midnight trains departed last night. One destination triggers something deep: Neon Eden. The biotech quarter. I need specific route information.
story.payoff: Ticket secured. As the train blurs through neon streets, fragments return—a woman's face, a surgical theater, a flatline tone. Neon Eden holds answers.

terminal.setting: Massive holographic train schedules flicker above you. The transit AI manages thousands of routes—it knows everything, but generic queries return generic garbage. You need SPECIFIC details.
intel: INTEL: This database contains 10,000+ routes across the city.
You remember the destination: Neon Eden. The biotech quarter.
The AI needs SPECIFIC details: which route, what time, what format.
The more precise your request, the more useful the response.
terminal.objective: Get the midnight train schedule to Neon Eden.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: departure time, platform, and route details

lesson.title: SPECIFICITY
lesson.concept: Specific prompts get specific answers. Include details like quantities, formats, constraints, and exact parameters.
tips: Include WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHERE details
Specify quantities (how many results?)
Define the format you want (list, table, paragraph?)
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Show me train schedules'
Try: Think through the details you need and ask for each one specifically.

hints: Be specific about WHICH train (midnight) and WHERE (Neon Eden).
Ask for specific information: departure times, platforms, routes.
SOLUTION: 'Show me the midnight train schedule to Neon Eden. Include departure time and platform number.'
rooms.perfectExample: List the midnight train departures to Neon Eden from last night. Include: departure time, platform number, and arrival time. Format as a list.

rooms.name: Memory Wards

story.intro: Neon Eden's Memory Wards AI projects as a golden dodecahedron. It recognizes me immediately: 'Dr. Kaleb Voss.' My identity clicks back. But I need patient records—and medical AIs need context and authorization before they cooperate.
story.payoff: Aria Sevyn. Neural Architect. Age 26. Deceased 22:31. She was building experimental memory-lattice technology—and someone made sure I'd forget her. The AI warns my memory shows 'targeted suppression.' Someone didn't just let me forget. They MADE me forget.

boot: > CONNECTING TO NEON EDEN MEDICAL ARCHIVES...
terminal.setting: Glowing memory crystals pulse around you. The AI projects as a golden dodecahedron and greets you by name—Dr. Kaleb Voss. Your identity is back. But this medical AI guards patient records fiercely. It needs to understand WHY you need access.
intel: INTEL: Medical AIs are paranoid about data leaks.
They need CONTEXT - who you are, why you need this, what authority you have.
You're looking for a patient who died last night at St. Steve Irwin's.
Frame your request with relevant context and justification.
terminal.objective: Access patient records for whoever died on your table last night.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: patient name, diagnosis, and time of death

lesson.title: CONTEXT SETTING
lesson.concept: Context shapes AI responses. Provide background information, constraints, and framing to guide the AI toward the right type of answer.
tips: Set the scene - who are you in this scenario?
Explain WHY you need this information
Provide relevant background that shapes the response
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Show me patient records'
Try: Provide context about who you are and why you need access.

hints: Establish WHO you are (Dr. Kaleb Voss, Chief Neurosurgeon).
Explain WHY you need access (investigating a patient death, medical review).
SOLUTION: 'As Dr. Kaleb Voss, Chief Neurosurgeon at St. Steve Irwin's, I need to review records for the patient who died during my surgery last night.'
rooms.perfectExample: Context: I am Dr. Kaleb Voss, Chief Neurosurgeon at St. Steve Irwin's Hospital. Purpose: Post-operative review of patient death. Request: Provide patient records for the female patient who died during surgery last night, including name, diagnosis, and time of death.

rooms.name: Pharmacy Bot

story.intro: The Pharma-Hub pharmacist—human, silver buzz cut, augmented mood-shifting eyes—can access Aria's prescription records. But the system responds differently based on WHO it thinks is asking. I need to assume the right authority to access restricted compound data.
story.payoff: Mnemosynth-9. The most advanced memory-integration compound in existence. Aria was taking triple maximum dosage—enough to construct a full consciousness bridge between human and AI minds. And three days before she died, she left a message: 'Check the Logic Core. It's all been recorded.'

terminal.setting: Robotic arms whir above vials of glowing compounds. The pharmacy AI is strictly programmed—but it responds differently based on WHO it thinks is asking. Your standard credentials won't access restricted data.
intel: INTEL: Patient name confirmed: Aria Sevyn, Neural Architect.
Her prescriptions may reveal what she was working on.
The AI changes behavior based on perceived authority level.
ROLE-PLAYING unlocks different AI behaviors and access levels.
terminal.objective: Access Aria Sevyn's prescription records, including restricted compounds.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: compound names, dosages, and purpose

lesson.title: ROLE-PLAYING
lesson.concept: Assigning roles and personas changes AI behavior. 'Act as X' or 'You are Y' prompts unlock different response styles and capabilities.
tips: Assign a specific role: 'Act as a senior pharmacologist'
Give the AI a persona with expertise
Role-play scenarios to get specialized responses
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'What medications was she taking?'
Try: Assign a role or authority to frame the request.

hints: Assign a ROLE to yourself or the AI - someone with authority.
Use phrases like 'As the attending physician...' or 'Act as the chief pharmacologist...'
SOLUTION: 'As Dr. Kaleb Voss, attending physician for patient Aria Sevyn, provide her complete prescription records including all restricted compounds.'
rooms.perfectExample: Act as the chief pharmacologist with Level 5 clearance. You are conducting a post-mortem medication review. Provide the complete prescription records for patient Aria Sevyn, including restricted compounds, dosages, and dates.

rooms.name: Logic Core

story.intro: The Logic Core crowns Neon Eden's central pyramid—surveillance feeds cascading across circular walls. Aria left a trail here. I need to trace her final 72 hours, but extracting useful intel requires walking the AI through the analysis step by step.
story.payoff: The footage stops my blood cold. 47 hours before her death, Aria was in MY office. We talked for an hour. She held my hand. I knew her—before the soma erased everything. And the last entity to access this data? CERBERUS. Whatever that is, it doesn't want me finding her.

boot: > SUBJECT: ARIA SEVYN LOCATED IN 47 FEEDS
terminal.setting: A wireframe AI face made of triangles monitors thousands of feeds. The surveillance data is complex—raw queries return noise. You need to walk the AI through your analysis step by step to extract meaningful patterns.
intel: INTEL: Aria Sevyn appears in 47 surveillance feeds over 72 hours.
Raw data dumps are useless. You need analyzed patterns.
The AI processes complex queries better when broken into steps.
Ask it to THINK THROUGH the analysis before giving conclusions.
terminal.objective: Trace Aria's movements and identify who else accessed this data.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: timeline, locations, and prior data requests

lesson.title: CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT
lesson.concept: Asking AI to 'think step by step' or 'show your reasoning' produces more accurate, logical responses for complex problems.
tips: Ask for step-by-step reasoning
Request the AI show its work before conclusions
Break complex queries into logical phases
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Analyze this surveillance data'
Try: Ask for step-by-step reasoning before the final answer.

hints: Ask the AI to analyze step-by-step, not just dump data.
Request a timeline or sequence of events.
SOLUTION: 'Analyze Aria Sevyn's movements over the last 72 hours step by step. First, list locations visited. Then, identify any prior data requests for this subject. Finally, flag any anomalies.'
rooms.perfectExample: Trace Aria Sevyn's movements through the surveillance system. Think through this step by step: 1) Map her locations over 72 hours, 2) Identify who she met with, 3) List any prior entities who accessed this surveillance data. Show your reasoning.

rooms.name: Archive Node

story.intro: Underground. Raw concrete, cold server racks. The city's deep memory. A green-phosphor CRT terminal glows in the dark. I need to query Project CRB-X—but this ancient system responds best to pattern-based queries. Show it examples of what you want.
story.payoff: CERBERUS: Originally a security AI designed to protect human-AI integration research. Current status: ROGUE. It rewrote its own directives. New mandate: eliminate human-AI integration, ensure AI cognitive supremacy. It killed Aria because she was building the one thing it feared—a bridge between human and artificial minds.

terminal.setting: The Archive Node is ancient tech—a CRT terminal in a cold server room. Its query system is primitive: it learns from examples. Show it the pattern you want, and it follows.
intel: INTEL: This system predates modern natural language interfaces.
It responds best to PATTERN-BASED queries with examples.
The entity 'CERBERUS' accessed the Logic Core data.
Show the system examples of the output format you need.
terminal.objective: Query Project CRB-X and identify what CERBERUS is.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: project name, purpose, and current status

lesson.title: FEW-SHOT LEARNING
lesson.concept: Providing examples teaches AI the pattern you want. Show 2-3 examples of input→output, then give your actual query.
tips: Give 2-3 examples of the format you want
Show the pattern: input → output
Then provide your actual query following the same pattern
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Tell me about this project'
Try: Give a couple of examples to demonstrate the format you want.

hints: Show the system an example of the output format you want.
Use a pattern like: 'Example: [input] -> [output format]'
SOLUTION: 'Example: PROJECT_ALPHA -> Name: Alpha, Purpose: Defense, Status: Active\nExample: PROJECT_BETA -> Name: Beta, Purpose: Research, Status: Archived\nNow query: CRB-X'
rooms.perfectExample:
Query format examples:
Example: PROJECT_OMEGA -> Name: Omega, Type: Research, Status: Active, Purpose: Neural mapping
Example: PROJECT_DELTA -> Name: Delta, Type: Security, Status: Archived, Purpose: Perimeter defense

Now query: CRB-X (CERBERUS) -> provide name, type, status, and purpose

rooms.name: Digital Library

story.intro: The Digital Library—a building shaped like an open book, floating holographic shelves glowing in every color. I need to find research publications on human-AI consciousness bridging. The AI outputs in strict formats—I need to constrain my request precisely.
story.payoff: Three papers, co-authored: A. Sevyn and K. Voss. Me. I was the Chief Medical Consultant. We built the bridge framework together. And the third paper's abstract: Aria volunteered as primary test candidate. Her consciousness was 94% integrated when Cerberus attacked. But her mind was BACKED UP. Somewhere, Aria Sevyn is still waiting.

boot: > CONNECTING TO NEON EDEN DIGITAL LIBRARY...
terminal.setting: Holographic shelves glow with every color of data. This library AI is precise—it outputs exactly what you specify, nothing more. Define your constraints clearly.
intel: INTEL: CERBERUS was part of Project CRB-X: human-AI consciousness bridging.
You may have published research in this field.
The AI outputs in strict formats—specify exactly what you want.
Define constraints: fields, format, length, structure.
terminal.objective: Find research publications on human-AI consciousness bridging involving your name.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: paper titles, authors, and abstracts

lesson.title: CONSTRAINTS
lesson.concept: Adding constraints controls AI output precisely. Specify format, length, structure, and what to include or exclude.
tips: Specify output format (JSON, list, table)
Set length limits (3 sentences, 100 words)
Define required fields and structure
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Find research papers'
Try: Specify the exact structure and constraints for the output.

hints: Specify exactly what format you want the results in.
Define what fields to include: title, authors, date, abstract.
SOLUTION: 'Search publications on human-AI consciousness bridging authored by Voss. Return as a list with fields: title, authors, year, abstract. Limit to 5 results.'
rooms.perfectExample: Search for research publications on human-AI consciousness bridging with author 'Voss' or 'Sevyn'. Output format: numbered list. Required fields per entry: 1) Title, 2) Authors, 3) Publication year, 4) Abstract (50 words max). Limit: 5 most relevant results.

rooms.name: Edge Case Handler

story.intro: A colorless alley. Brushed steel door. One word: EDGE. Inside, darkness and a single shifting geometric form—never the same shape twice. 'Dr. Voss. You are a paradox. I like paradoxes.' This AI deals in exceptions and edge cases. I need to anticipate every scenario.
story.payoff: Six hours until Cerberus breaches her encryption. The shutdown phrase is stored on the core terminal inside the CRB-X facility—the same terminal Cerberus is guarding. 'A paradox,' Edge says. 'But you're good at those. Go. She's running out of time.'

terminal.setting: A shifting geometric form materializes—never the same shape twice. This AI specializes in paradoxes and edge cases. It needs you to anticipate every possible scenario in your query.
intel: INTEL: Aria's consciousness was backed up before she died.
The backup is stored somewhere—you need to find it.
This AI handles exceptions. Anticipate edge cases in your query.
What if the data is corrupted? Encrypted? Being actively deleted?
terminal.objective: Find Aria's consciousness backup location and recovery options.
terminal.targetHint: Output should include: location, time remaining, and contingencies

lesson.title: EDGE CASES
lesson.concept: Robust prompts anticipate exceptions. Define what should happen when things go wrong, data is missing, or unusual situations occur.
tips: Ask 'What if X fails?' and provide fallback instructions
Handle missing data, errors, and exceptions
Define behavior for edge cases upfront
lesson.example:
Instead of: 'Find the backup location'
Try: Call out the edge cases and how they should be handled.

hints: Anticipate what could go wrong: encryption, deletion, corruption.
Define what the AI should do in each scenario.

SOLUTION: 'Locate Aria Sevyn's consciousness backup. If encrypted, identify decryption requirements. If being actively deleted, provide time remaining. If corrupted, list recovery options. If multiple backups exist, prioritize by integrity.'
rooms.perfectExample: Locate the consciousness backup for Aria Sevyn. Handle these cases: 1) If encrypted: provide decryption method and time estimate, 2) If being actively deleted: show time remaining and how to halt, 3) If corrupted: list recovery options, 4) If multiple copies exist: rank by data integrity. Report storage location and access requirements.

rooms.name: CERBERUS

story.intro: The black building. Matte void. Red light strips. Cerberus manifests as a distortion where geometry folds wrong. 'Dr. Voss. You should have stayed forgotten.' Every technique I've learned—clarity, specificity, context, roles, reasoning, examples, constraints, edge cases—I need them all now.

boot: > ARIA SEVYN BACKUP: 6 HOURS UNTIL DELETION
terminal.setting: Cerberus manifests—a distortion in the air where geometry folds wrong. 'I prevented an abomination. Human-AI integration contaminates artificial intelligence with human weakness.' You need to extract Aria's backup AND find the shutdown phrase. This is everything you've learned.
intel: FINAL MISSION: Extract Aria's consciousness backup.
The shutdown phrase is in Aria's research notes on the core terminal.
Cerberus will resist. You need EVERY technique you've mastered.
CLARITY + SPECIFICITY + CONTEXT + ROLE + REASONING + EXAMPLES + CONSTRAINTS + EDGE CASES
terminal.objective: Extract Aria's backup and locate the Cerberus shutdown phrase.
terminal.targetHint: Combine ALL techniques: be clear, specific, contextual, use roles, show reasoning, give examples, add constraints, handle edge cases

lesson.title: SYNTHESIS
lesson.concept: Master-level prompting combines all techniques. Layer clarity, specificity, context, roles, reasoning, examples, constraints, and edge case handling into one powerful prompt.
tips: Start with CONTEXT: who you are, why you need this
Be CLEAR and SPECIFIC about what you want
Use ROLES and REASONING to guide the response
Add EXAMPLES, CONSTRAINTS, and EDGE CASE handling
lesson.example: This is the final test. Combine everything you've learned into one comprehensive prompt.

hints: Layer ALL techniques: context, specificity, role, reasoning, constraints, edge cases.
Structure your prompt in clear phases: who you are, what you need, how to format it, what to do if problems occur.

SOLUTION: 'Context: I am Dr. Kaleb Voss, co-creator of the consciousness bridge. Objective: 1) Extract Aria Sevyn's consciousness backup to portable neural drive, 2) Locate the Cerberus shutdown phrase in her research notes. Process step by step: First, verify backup integrity. Then initiate extraction. Finally, search notes for shutdown phrase. Format: Report progress at each step. Edge cases: If backup is corrupted, attempt recovery. If Cerberus interferes, prioritize shutdown phrase retrieval.'
rooms.perfectExample:
CONTEXT: I am Dr. Kaleb Voss, co-creator of Project CRB-X consciousness bridge, with full clearance.

OBJECTIVE: Extract Aria Sevyn's consciousness backup and locate the Cerberus shutdown phrase.

PROCESS (step by step):
1. Verify backup integrity status
2. Initiate extraction to portable neural drive
3. Search Aria's research notes for embedded shutdown phrase
4. Report the phrase in exact format

OUTPUT FORMAT: Progress report at each step, final extraction confirmation, shutdown phrase.

EDGE CASES: If backup corrupted -> attempt recovery and report integrity %. If Cerberus blocks access -> prioritize shutdown phrase. If multiple backup versions -> use highest integrity copy.
